## Unclassified stage tags

- [Legend Star Startup CEO Training Program](<programs/ceo-b6e55d42.md>): recorded stage text is `Existing startup founders / CEOs`.

## Provenance & assets

Original archive: 150 program records and 7 metadata records. Its byte-for-byte SHA-256 is recorded in [provenance.json](../data/source/provenance.json).

Logo paths, source URLs and layout metadata are preserved. The referenced `/program-logos/` image files were not included in the JSONL and are not bundled or displayed by this repository.

English facts and original-language facts are retained separately. Empty values remain null; unknown funding amounts are not converted to zero.

## Limits of these checks

CI validates structure and reproducible exports. It does not visit the 150 program websites, confirm deadlines, infer visa commitments, or update editorial opinions. Corrections need source evidence and a genuine verification date.
